entity.name: Ebenworks Systems (Private) Limited
entity.description: A small software company building tools for people who need to be findable and credible on the open web — researchers, public figures and independent professionals.

projects.name: Tzohar Sites
projects.description: A framework for bespoke personal and academic websites. Pages are composed from typed section blocks rather than templates, so a site is data a person owns rather than a layout they rent. Built for researchers and public figures: publication lists with ORCID and BibTeX import, citation export, lab and research-group pages, CV export, multilingual routing, and structured data. Every site is the same engine configured, so improvements reach every site that runs it.

channels.description: Bank transfer. Details on request to hello@ebenworks.co.

plans.name: Academic publishing features
plans.description: Deepen the parts researchers depend on: Google Scholar and Semantic Scholar import alongside the existing ORCID and BibTeX paths, citation-count display, group and lab directories, and WCAG conformance testing across every section type.

plans.name: Ongoing maintenance
plans.description: Dependency and framework upgrades, security patching, accessibility and performance work, and support for the people running sites on the engine.
